text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I'm gonna win! This is my chance to—)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Oguri Cap! Oguri Cap has taken
the lead!
She takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, Oguri! And she even trounced
Tama too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I hate to admit defeat, but Oguri's way
ahead of
me! I can't leave things like
this!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I've got to train up even more! MUCH
more!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait. I'm gonna beat you
someday!
